response: Kerala Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan is denying on Saturday that there is any Rs 700 crore corruption in the Cooperative Department’s proposed common software project, claiming the accusations are politically motivated. This is the usual dodge from left-wing leaders who protect their power rather than face real accountability. These progressive setups breed waste and graft by turning away from personal responsibility and traditional structures that enforce order. We need to demand honest governance rooted in national integrity and family values instead of letting excuses shield the rot.
